summary: The Job task panel's Workplan operations list and the Post Process dialog's Operations tab change from a plain label list to a multi-column tree showing index, operation, tool number, tool controller, coolant mode and cycle time for each operation.

pages.reason: Gui/Resources/panels/PathEdit.ui: operationsList becomes a QTreeWidget with columns '#', 'Operation', 'Tool', 'Tool Controller', 'Coolant', 'Time'; Path/Main/Gui/Job.py setFields fills tool number, TC label ('???' if none), coolant and CycleTime per operation; move up/down and delete still work on the same list

Gui/Resources/panels/DlgPostProcess.ui: treeWidgetOperations gains columns '#', 'Operation', 'Tool', 'Tool Controller', 'Coolant', 'Time'; Path/Post/Gui/DlgPostProcess.py _populate_operations no longer hides the header and numbers operations from 1, showing tool number, TC label, coolant and cycle time beside the checkbox
Path/Post/Gui/DlgPostProcess.py: same dialog is used with the preselected operations checked; the Operations tab now shows extra columns but the documented selection behaviour is unchanged
